title: Free model registry shared by backend and Android client
description: Single source of truth for the free models the product is allowed to serve. The backend enforces this allow-list; the Android client uses it to render pickers without contacting the network.

primaryModelId.description: Model used first for every request (Big Pickle).

maxFallbackDepth.description: How many fallback models may be tried before a request fails.

endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions path appended to the configured base URL. Must be https in production.

priority.description: Lower is tried first. The primary model must have the lowest priority.

fallbackOnly.description: When true the model is never selected directly by the user, only via fallback.
